headline: MISSED CATCH-UP (Sunday Oct 25, in no prior scan) -- Dakar Rally 2027 moved out of Saudi Arabia over security concerns
dek: The 2027 Dakar Rally, scheduled 1-15 January 2027 and held in Saudi Arabia since 2020, will NOT be held in the Kingdom 'following recent developments in the region'; it moves to a different territory to be announced in the coming days and returns to Saudi Arabia for its 50th edition in 2028.…
sources: Amaury Sport Organisation (ASO) + Saudi Motorsport Company joint statement, Oct 25, as reported by Reuters and Al Jazeera liveblog
fault_line: Is the Gulf's big-event economy now a casualty of the war -- or is one moved rally just prudent scheduling that proves nothing?
